02 / About

About me

7+years in BIM and design standardization
25+Shell EV charging stations drafted across India
8+sites modelled at LOD 200
3disciplines coordinated: architecture, structure, MEP

Results-driven BIM Manager and Civil Engineer with over 7 years of experience in Building Information Modeling (BIM), Design Standardization and Project Visualization. Expert in managing multidisciplinary BIM workflows (Architecture, Structure, MEP) and using 4D simulation to optimize construction timelines. A proven record of improving project delivery efficiency, backed by corporate recognition from Shell Oil & Gas for developing the NGVC Archetypes.

Core competencies

BIM management

  • Multidisciplinary coordination (LOD 200 to 400)
  • BIM Execution Plans (BEP)
  • Design standardization

Technical coordination

  • Advanced clash detection
  • Navisworks workflows
  • 4D construction simulation

Visualization and rendering

  • High-fidelity 3D walkthroughs
  • Photorealistic rendering in Lumion, Twinmotion and D5 Render

Civil engineering

  • Structural analysis (STAAD-Pro)
  • Site surveys
  • High-rise design
